hook: At 50,000 users, Auth0 B2C Essentials bills $3,500 a month and Clerk Pro bills $25, a 140x gap that is mostly a units error. Clerk counts users who came back on a later day, Auth0 counts everyone who logged in, and most head-to-heads divide one by the other as if they were the same people.

sections.title: Clerk and Auth0 count different people
sections.content:
Read the unit before the price. Each vendor defines it in its own words:

| Vendor | Unit | Who is billed |
|---|---|---|
| Clerk | Monthly Retained User (MRU) | a user who visits at least one day after signing up |
| Auth0 | Monthly Active User (MAU) | any non-internal user that authenticated during the month for a given tenant |

Clerk counts the first day free. A user who signs up and never returns is never billed; Auth0 bills that same user the moment they log in.

> A consumer app with heavy sign-up churn will look cheap on Clerk, and part of that cheapness is definitional.

For teams picking auth for a consumer or B2B product. Every figure comes from the vendors' pricing pages as checked on 10 November 2026, plus arithmetic with the formula shown. No benchmarks.

sections.title: Clerk sells a product surface, Auth0 sells identity plumbing
sections.content:
> **Clerk:** authentication is a product surface, so it ships prebuilt UI, organisations and billing, and prices retained attention.

> **Auth0:** identity is infrastructure, so it sells connections, tenants and actions, and prices authenticated humans in tiers.

What each philosophy forbids:

- Clerk forbids a limitless free tier: Hobby stops at 50,000 MRU per app with no MFA or passkeys, and one month of grace before the app stops working.
- Clerk forbids big free organisations: 100 MRO per app, 20 members each. An MRO has at least 2 members, one of them an MRU that month.
- Auth0 forbids paying for exactly what you use. Between tiers you are billed at the next tier up.
- Auth0 forbids self-serve B2C enterprise SSO. Essentials and Professional list it as "not available".

sections.title: On Auth0, the 501st user costs $35
sections.content:
Auth0's B2C price is a staircase. You pay for the tier you land in:

| B2C MAU | Essentials | Professional |
|---|---|---|
| 500 | $35 | $240 |
| 1,000 | $70 | $240 |
| 20,000 | $1,400 | $3,200 |
| 30,000 | $2,100 | contact us |
| 40,000 | $2,800 | not available |
| 50,000 | $3,500 | not available |

At 500 MAU, Essentials is $35 / 500 = $0.07 per user. User 501 moves you to the 1,000 tier: $70 − $35 = $35 for one person.

**The usage punished is a spike that crosses a boundary.** One launch week past a tier line bills the whole next tier. Professional has a harder cliff: $240 climbing to $3,200, then no self-serve price at all.

Annual billing keeps the steps: yearly is 11 × monthly, so 50,000 MAU on Essentials is 11 × $3,500 = $38,500.

sections.title: Clerk's meter is cheap; the add-ons carry the bill
sections.content:
Clerk Pro is $25/month, or $20/month billed annually. It includes 50,000 MRU per app, then $0.02 per MRU with volume discounts. Every plan allows unlimited applications.

The add-ons move the bill:

| Add-on | Price | Punishes |
|---|---|---|
| SSO connection | 1 included, then $75/mo | one connection per customer |
| Directory Sync | 1 included, then $75/mo from 1 January 2027 | SCIM-heavy B2B |
| B2B Enhanced | $100/mo, 100 MRO included, then $1 each | many small organisations |
| Protect | 10,000 checks free, then $0.002 each | bot-heavy sign-up forms |

Ten enterprise customers, one SSO connection each, cost (10 − 1) × $75 = $675/month. **From January 2027, Directory Sync for the same ten adds another (10 − 1) × $75 = $675.** Protect at 200,000 checks is (200,000 − 10,000) × $0.002 = $380.

sections.title: The 140x gap is correct arithmetic on two different quantities
sections.content:
The quoted head-to-head, as code. Auth0 counts MAU; Clerk counts MRU.

```python
TIERS = [(500, 35), (1_000, 70), (2_500, 175), (5_000, 350), (7_500, 525),
         (10_000, 700), (20_000, 1_400), (30_000, 2_100), (40_000, 2_800), (50_000, 3_500)]

def auth0(mau):  # between tiers you pay the next tier up
    return next((p for cap, p in TIERS if mau <= cap), None)  # breaks: >50,000 unpriced

def clerk_pro(mru):  # ignores Clerk's volume discounts
    return 25 + max(0, mru - 50_000) * 0.02

for n in (501, 50_000, 100_000):
    print(n, auth0(n), clerk_pro(n))
```

At 50,000: Auth0 is $3,500; Clerk is $25 + 0 × $0.02 = $25. $3,500 / $25 = 140.

> 140x prices 50,000 people who logged in against 50,000 who came back on a later day. Not the same crowd.

At 100,000 MRU, Clerk is 50,000 × $0.02 + $25 = $1,025/month. Auth0's B2C sheet ends at 50,000: "contact us".

sections.title: Pick by who you are billed for, then check the next boundary
sections.content:
**Clerk wins if** most sign-ups never return, or you sell B2B where organisations and prebuilt UI are the product. A 10-person SaaS with 5,000 users and 200 organisations on Clerk Business pays $300 + $100 + (200 − 100) × $1 = $500/month; Auth0 B2B Essentials at 5,000 MAU is $1,300.

Auth0 wins for an identity programme: enterprise SSO, 12 tenants on Professional, custom database connections, procurement. Avoid Clerk's self-serve plans if you need a 99.99% SLA or a HIPAA BAA; both are Enterprise-only.

Check today:

1. Count last month's logins, then users who returned on a later day. That ratio is the definitional share of the gap.
2. Find your Auth0 tier and how many MAU separate you from the next one.
3. List SSO and Directory Sync connections you will run on 1 January 2027.

decision_matrix.situation: Consumer app where most sign-ups never come back, under 50,000 retained users per app
decision_matrix.why: Users who never return after day one are never billed, and the first 50,000 MRU are inside the $25/month.

decision_matrix.situation: Side project that needs more than 3 social logins and costs nothing
decision_matrix.why: Auth0 Free includes unlimited social connections up to 25,000 MAU, while Clerk Hobby stops at 3 social connections.

decision_matrix.pick: Clerk Pro, or an Auth0 Enterprise quote
decision_matrix.why: Clerk keeps charging $0.02 per MRU past 50,000; Auth0's B2C price sheet ends at 50,000 MAU and turns into "contact us".

decision_matrix.situation: B2B SaaS with 5,000 users across 200 organisations
decision_matrix.why: $300 + $100 + (200 − 100) × $1 = $500/month, against $1,300 for Auth0 B2B Essentials at 5,000 MAU.

decision_matrix.situation: Existing user store you cannot migrate yet (bring your own database)
decision_matrix.why: Custom database connections and cross-app SSO are Professional-and-up features on Auth0.

decision_matrix.situation: Auth0 Essentials customer sitting just under a tier line with no feature gaps
decision_matrix.why: The step only costs you when you cross it, so measure your headroom to the next tier before pricing a migration.

decision_matrix.situation: AI agent product that needs Token Vault and CIBA on Auth0
decision_matrix.why: Auth0 for AI Agents adds 50% to the base price, so B2B Essentials at 5,000 MAU goes from $1,300 to $1,950.

decision_matrix.situation: Healthcare app that needs HIPAA with a BAA
decision_matrix.why: Clerk lists HIPAA with BAA only on its annual Enterprise plan, and Auth0 Enterprise pricing is quote-only too, so no self-serve tier settles it.

verdict_summary: Clerk wins if most of your sign-ups never return or if organisations and prebuilt UI are what you sell: 50,000 retained users fit inside Pro's $25/month, and 5,000 users in 200 organisations cost $500/month. Auth0 wins if you run an identity programme with enterprise SSO, multiple tenants and procurement, once you have checked which side of the next MAU tier boundary you sit on.

faqs.q: Does Auth0 have a free tier?
faqs.a: Yes: Auth0 Free is $0 up to 25,000 MAU, with 1 tenant, 5 organizations, 1 enterprise connection and 1-day log retention. Self-service SSO and SCIM are included on it.

faqs.q: Do I need Clerk Business to offer SSO?
faqs.a: No. SSO connections are a Pro add-on; Business ($300/month, $250 annual) adds a SOC 2 report, 10 dashboard seats and 30-day application and admin logs.

faqs.q: How long does each vendor keep logs on the paid tiers?
faqs.a: Auth0 keeps 5 days on Essentials, 10 on Professional and 30 on Enterprise. Clerk Pro keeps 7 days of logs and Business keeps 30.

faqs.q: What does SMS login cost on Clerk?
faqs.a: SMS authentication is on Pro at $0.01 per SMS for the US and Canada, with international messages at market rate.
